lines.34: 「Blue or black. I don't want anything frivolous.」

lines.112: 「You're overreacting again. It didn't even cost a thousand yen.」

lines.117: 「If you've got a problem with it, I'll take it back.」
lines.118: 「No. It is true that the phone would look bland without anything, so I will accept it.」

lines.148: 「You too...! When it comes to games, I recognize you as my rival.」
lines.149: I don't think I want that recognition.

lines.164: She's an idiot, but her instincts are sharp.
